title: Meeting agenda items, tracks, and moving a feature to another PRD or track
subtitle: Three decisions so every agenda item, track and a feature's PRD and track can be changed in Simple

decisions.name: Meeting agenda items
decisions.question: How does a person add, rename, reorder and remove agenda items in a live review meeting?
decisions.common: Items are the PRD's features or a typed topic; done and current items stay fixed; a removed item goes to Settings > Trash with Undo; an owner changes the agenda, an approver who is not the meeting's decider proposes (it waits for the decider, by name, with Withdraw), a viewer reads; 'next' and 'skip' in the chat still work.

proposals.name: Edit strip in place
proposals.what: Edit agenda turns the strip under the attendees into an editable row: each item gets a drag handle and ×, a click on its name renames it, and + Add joins the end. Done closes it.
proposals.plus: Nothing opens; the change happens where people already look.
proposals.cost: A long agenda wraps into rows that push the stage down; small handles on a phone; no way to reorder by keyboard or set minutes.

frames.caption: At rest: the agenda strip lists every item in order, with Edit agenda at its end.
Edit agenda pressed: each item not yet done gets a drag handle and ×, and + Add joins the end.
Mid-drag: Quiet hours for muted teams lifted and held before Mobile alert push; the blue line shows where it lands.
Done: Quiet hours is 3rd and renamed, Beta date sign-off added, Alert history export in Settings > Trash; one line says so, with Undo and Open Trash.
At 1512 with 13 items: the strip wraps to three rows and pushes the one-pager down; long names take a row each.
A viewer: the same strip with no Edit agenda; View only at its end.
An approver who is not the meeting's decider: the agenda stays as it was; a Proposed chip, with what is proposed behind its (i), waits for Priya Raman, with Withdraw.
Phone 390, editing: the chips wrap down the screen; handles are small to hit.

proposals.name: An agenda sheet
proposals.what: The strip says Now, Next and Item 2 of 5, with Edit agenda. It opens the Agenda sheet: numbered rows with minutes, up and down arrows (and dragging), Rename in place, ×, and an Add box for a feature or a typed topic. On a phone it is a bottom sheet.
proposals.why: It holds a long agenda without pushing the stage down, works the same on a phone, gives arrows for those who cannot drag, and has room for minutes and who added a topic.
proposals.plus: Same sheet pattern as elsewhere; scales to many items.
proposals.cost: One more step: the agenda is one click away instead of on the strip.

frames.caption: At rest: the strip says Now, Next and Item 2 of 5, with Edit agenda at its end.

Edit agenda opens the Agenda sheet: every item numbered, with its minutes and 'topic' on its second line, arrows, Rename and ×; done and current items are fixed, and the item after Now has no up arrow.
Mid-rename: item 4 renamed to Quiet hours by default in place, with Save and Cancel.
Done: the strip reads on; one line says Quiet hours moved up and renamed, Beta date sign-off added, Alert history export in Settings > Trash, with Undo and Open Trash.
At 1512 with 13 items: the sheet scrolls; the strip stays one line.
A viewer: See agenda opens the same sheet with no controls; View only in its head.
An approver who is not the meeting's decider: the strip is unchanged; a Proposed chip, with what is proposed behind its (i), waits for Priya Raman, with Withdraw.
Phone 390: the sheet rises from the bottom; arrows give a way to reorder without dragging.

proposals.name: By chat only
proposals.what: The strip lists the whole agenda; people change it by typing add, rename, move or remove in the meeting chat, and Oracle reads it back on a card to confirm.
proposals.plus: No new controls; extends the 'next' and 'skip' people already use.
proposals.cost: Each change needs the item's name typed right; hard to see how to do it; slow for several changes.

frames.caption: At rest: the strip lists the whole agenda; Change it in the chat, with an (i) that names the words to type.
Oracle's card under the strip, after one move typed in the chat: Do it or Cancel.
Several changes typed at once: Oracle reads back the rename, the add and the removal to confirm.
Done: the agenda in its new order; one line says what changed, with Undo and Open Trash.
At 1512 with 13 items: the strip wraps to three rows; every change still needs the item's name typed right.
A viewer: the same strip, View only, no card.
An approver who is not the meeting's decider: the agenda stays as it was; a Proposed chip, with what is proposed behind its (i), waits for Priya Raman, with Withdraw.
Phone 390: the strip wraps and the confirm card sits under it, far from the chat box below.

decisions.name: Tracks
decisions.question: Where in Simple are tracks added, renamed, given an owner, paused, closed and moved to Trash?
decisions.common: A track has a name, an owner, a state (active, paused, closed) and its PRD; Move to Trash goes to Settings > Trash, restorable with Undo; an owner changes it, an approver who is not the track's owner proposes (it waits for the track's owner, by name, with Withdraw), a viewer reads; Detailed's /plan track panel stays as is.

proposals.name: Menu on lane header
proposals.what: On the Gantt grouped by track, each lane header has a ⋯ menu: Rename, Owner, Pause, Close, Move to Trash. + Add track sits at the head of the Track column.
proposals.plus: Right where the track is drawn.
proposals.cost: Only on the Gantt by track; paused, closed and empty tracks have no lane, so they cannot be reached; long names do not fit the 186-pixel header.

frames.caption: At rest: the Gantt grouped by track; each lane header has a ⋯ and the Track column has + Add track.
⋯ on Guided setup track: Rename, Owner, Pause, Close, Move to Trash.
Rename picked: the name becomes a field on the lane header, with Save and Cancel.
Done: the lane reads Setup and onboarding; a note at the bottom says so, with Undo.
At 1512, a long name: the 186-pixel lane header cannot show 'Admin console and team settings for large accounts'; paused, closed and empty tracks have no lane at all, so they cannot be reached here.
A viewer: no ⋯ and no + Add track.
An approver who is not the track's owner renames it: the lane keeps its name; the note says the rename waits for Marco Ilves, with Withdraw.
Phone 390: the lane's ⋯ opens a bottom sheet over the tab bar, the track's name whole in its head, with Rename, Owner, Pause, Close and Move to Trash.

proposals.name: A Tracks sheet
proposals.what: A Tracks · N button with the roadmap's filters opens a sheet listing every track, paused, closed and empty ones too, with owner, state and feature count. A row opens to Name, Owner, State and Move to Trash; + Add track is in its head.
proposals.why: Every track is reachable from any view, whatever is drawn, and the same sheet works on a phone.
proposals.plus: One place for all tracks; long names wrap.
proposals.cost: The change is made away from the lane it changes.

frames.caption: At rest: a Tracks · 3 button sits with the roadmap's filters.
The Tracks sheet: + Add track on its own line at the top; every track with its owner, features and state, paused ones too; Guided setup track open to change, with Hide to fold it.
Mid-rename in the sheet: Setup and onboarding typed, with Save and Cancel; owner, state and Move to Trash under it.
Done: the lane reads Setup and onboarding; a note at the bottom says so, with Undo.
At 1512 with 11 tracks: the sheet lists all of them, closed and empty ones too, and scrolls.
A viewer: the same list, View only, no Change or + Add track.
An approver who is not the track's owner renames it: the lane keeps its name; the note says the rename waits for Marco Ilves, with Withdraw.
Phone 390: the Tracks sheet rises from the bottom; the same rows.

proposals.name: A track panel
proposals.what: A click on a lane header opens a track panel, like the feature panel: name, owner, state, PRD and its features, each changed in place, with Move to Trash. + Track sits with the filters.
proposals.plus: Mirrors the one feature panel; lists the track's features.
proposals.cost: Opened only from a lane that exists, so paused, closed and empty tracks cannot be opened; a panel for four fields.

frames.caption: At rest: the Gantt grouped by track; a lane header is a button and + Track sits with the filters.
Guided setup track clicked: its track panel with name, owner, state, PRD, its features and Move to Trash.
Mid-rename in the panel: Setup and onboarding typed, with Save and Cancel.
Done: the lane reads Setup and onboarding; a note says so, with Undo.
At 1512 with many tracks: the panel is the same, but only tracks with a lane can be opened; paused, closed and empty ones cannot.
A viewer: the panel reads only; a View only chip, with who can change it behind its (i).
An approver who is not the track's owner renames it: the lane keeps its name; the note says the rename waits for Marco Ilves, with Withdraw.
Phone 390: the track panel fills the screen.

decisions.name: Moving a feature
decisions.question: How does a person move a feature to another PRD or track?
decisions.common: A feature moves only within the company's one roadmap and keeps its dates, links and goal; an owner or the feature's decider moves it, an approver who is not its decider proposes (it waits for the decider, by name, with Withdraw), a viewer reads; Undo after a move.

proposals.name: Fields in the panel
proposals.what: The feature panel's Details gets PRD and Track rows, changed in place like every other field: pick a PRD, then one of its tracks, then Save or Propose.
proposals.why: It follows the rule that every field is changed in the one feature panel, so it works from every page that opens a feature, on a phone and by keyboard.
proposals.plus: No new pattern to learn; read-only and propose states come free.
proposals.cost: Two fields in an already long panel; the move is not seen on the chart until it is saved.

frames.caption: At rest: Welcome video's panel; Details has PRD and Track rows like every other field.
Track clicked: the PRD's tracks to pick from, the current one marked.
Welcome media track picked: Save or Cancel; what stays is behind the (i).
Done: Track reads Welcome media track; a note says so, with Undo.
At 1512, to another PRD: PRD set to Usage alerts lists that PRD's tracks only.
A viewer: PRD and Track read as text, like the panel's other fields.
An approver who is not the feature's decider: Track keeps Guided setup track with a Proposed chip, the move behind its (i); the note says it waits for Marco Ilves, with Withdraw.
Phone 390: the full-screen panel; PRD and Track sit in Details like every field.

proposals.name: A 'Move to' picker
proposals.what: The panel's head names the PRD and track and has a Move to… button: a picker of every PRD with its tracks, then a confirm button.
proposals.plus: The move reads as one clear action; all places in one list.
proposals.cost: A second way to change a field the panel already shows; the picker grows with every PRD.

frames.caption: At rest: the panel's head adds the PRD and track line and a Move to… button.
Move to… opened: every PRD with its tracks, the current one marked now.
Welcome media track picked: Move to Welcome media track or Cancel; what stays is behind the (i).
Done: the head reads Guided setup · Welcome media track; a note says so, with Undo.
At 1512 with five PRDs and their tracks: the picker lists all five under the panel's head, inside its left column.
A viewer: no Move to…; the head still names the PRD and track.
An approver who is not the feature's decider: the head still names Guided setup track; the note says the move waits for Marco Ilves, with Withdraw.
Phone 390: the panel full screen; Move to… sits in its head.

proposals.name: Drag between lanes
proposals.what: On the Gantt grouped by track, a row is lifted and dropped on another lane; while dragging, every track, empty ones too, becomes a drop place.
proposals.plus: Direct and quick on a big screen.
proposals.cost: Only on the Gantt by track; no phone and no keyboard; a long drag on a tall chart; easy to drop by mistake.

frames.caption: At rest: the Gantt grouped by track; rows can be lifted.
Row lifted: the empty Welcome media track appears as a drop place under the lanes, the lifted row beside it.
Held over Welcome media track: it lights up; Let go to move.
Done: Welcome video sits in its own Welcome media track lane; a note says so, with Undo.
At 1512 the drop places sit below every lane: a long drag down the page, past the chart's end.
A viewer: rows do not lift; there is nothing to drop on.
An approver who is not the feature's decider drops it: the row stays; the note says the move waits for Marco Ilves, with Withdraw.
Phone 390: no dragging on a phone, so a feature cannot be moved here at all.
